players.product: Power Systems division: backup engines and gas engines for prime power at data centres; next-generation engine to replace the Series 4000, targeting the data centre market with increased power density (launch 2028)

quarterly_data.quarter: Rolls-Royce press release: More flexible, more efficient, electric: Rolls-Royce (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Product launch (release): Rolls-Royce expanded its marine propulsion range with standardised variable-speed mtu generator sets based on the Series 2000, in 8V, 10V, 12V and 16V models, with an operating speed range of approximately 1,200 to 2,450 rpm and an electrical output of 650 to 1,850 kWe; Rolls-Royce says they reduce fuel consumption and CO2 emissions by up to 15 percent compared with fixed-speed units and operate about 6 dB quieter, for ferries, crew boats, offshore supply vessels, yachts and patrol boats.
quarterly_data.figure: 650 to 1,850 kWe; up to 15 percent lower fuel consumption
